newsitem.title: JAPAN: DKB to brief media at 1000 GMT on new leadership.
newsitem.headline: DKB to brief media at 1000 GMT on new leadership.

text.p: Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd said on Tuesday that it would hold a news conference at 7.00 p.m. (1000 GMT) on planned changes in top-level company personnel and a restructuring of the bank's organisation.
The news conference will be held at the bank's Tokyo headquarters.
Earlier, the bank named managing director Katsuyuki Sugita as its new president. The appointment is to take effect on June 27.
The bank also said managing directors Takasuke Kaneko and Tamiki Ishihara would become executive vice-presidents.
